تخترقن (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِقْنَ (taḵtariqna) /tax.ta.riq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# تُخْتَرَقْنَ (tuḵtaraqna) /tux.ta.raq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
